Author: Kausik Chanda
Bench: Kausik Chanda
06.06.2024 Item No.4 Court No.8 Vacation Bench Chc/S. De Rejected Crm (Db) 1756 of 2024

In
re : An Application for Bail under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection with
Harishchandrapur Police Station Case No. 439/2023 dated 17.05.2023 under Sections 498A, 304B,
302, 120B, 34 of the Indian Penal Code.

-And- 
In the matter of : Muther Ali @ Muthar Ali @ Mutahar Ali ... ... Petitioner Mr. Sagar Saha, Mr. Nur
Nobi Sk ... ...

entities.text: Muther Ali @ Muthar Ali @ Mutahar Ali
entities.label: PETITIONER

sentences.text: For the Petitioner Mrs. Anasuya Sinha, Ld. A.P.P. Mr. Bitasok Banerjee, ... ...For the State Petitioner prays for bail.
Having regard to the complicity of the petitioner in the alleged commission of offence, we are not inclined to grant bail to the petitioner at this stage.
State shall immediately serve copy of the charge-sheet upon the petitioner and the Learned Magistrate in the court below is directed to expedite the process of commitment.
The prayer for bail of the petitioner stands rejected.

(Kausik Chanda, J.) (Apurba Sinha Ray, J.) Signed By :
